limits: Digital geometry only; no measured plywood, adhesive, buckling or torsional qualification.

mass.note: Reference prior 2.548072866 kg plus this wing change only; other concurrent all-ply changes excluded, rescale demand to final mass.

beam_screen.basis: Actual current X sections; perfect continuous glue, fixed X50.2, uniform half-wing lift; no joint slip, peel, torsion, shear deformation, buckling or material strength qualification.

skin_envelope_method: Exact source section wires sampled at 0.01mm deflection; exterior upper/lower Z envelope at every sampled Y vertex fills the intentional hollow interior. Distance is a sampled section screen, not global minimum wall-thickness certification.

skin_summary.qualified_section_scope: Outside pre-existing source openings; all revised wood also checked against exact continuous exterior wrap surfaces.

exact_outer_surface_check.method: BRep minimum distance from each revised plywood solid to the original largest continuous exterior B-spline wrap face of all four foam panels. Independently supplements section envelopes, which are incomplete across original cutouts X485..500. Raw original surface retained; no healing.

profile_verification_note: DXF sampled curve area times 6 mm agrees with exact stock volume within 1 mm3; largest observed error is a sampled rib curve, not a thickness mismatch. All stock-face normals are explicitly selected by material thickness axis.
